design.additional_same_event_physical_bridge: Before held-out generation, add the proved direct semigroup bridge sigma>=4g/Delta and its nonlinear refinement phi(2g)/Delta. These reuse each joint method's exact confidence event and do not alter records, scores, parameter choices or alpha. Report separately from the older quadratic bridge so statistical and physical improvements can be compared.
design.comparison: Same analog records and calibration for all methods. Split baselines call the actual sixth-edition analog/calibration APIs. Tuned means the fixed analytic design s=3/4, chosen before any held-out draws; base s=1/2 recovers the sixth benchmark contrast. Virtual coin processing draws Bernoulli((1+Z0 Zt)/2) from the same pairs. No same-state twins are acquired.

costs_per_method_per_dataset.overhead: Stationary preparation, resets, detector operations and calibration overhead are unmeasured, not zero. No joule conversion is asserted. All six methods use identical data, making their physical overhead equal.

design.negative_control_repair: Subtract a declared zero-lag conditional-mean discrepancy bound 1/2; this covers every possible bounded-detector calibration mismatch and can be uninformative. Report separately from incorrectly asserted same-channel certificates.
design.selection: All rates, detector models, quotas, contrasts, decision rules and seeds frozen before held-out generation. Six separate methods are compared; no unadjusted maximum or same-data parameter selection is claimed.

evidence: Synthetic frozen held-out stationary experiments; no new physical measurements

scope: Matched raw data and resources; six predeclared statistical methods are reported individually. Their maximum is not a 95% certificate. The methods table keeps the earlier quadratic physical bridge to isolate statistical design; direct_bridges reuses each joint method's same confidence event for the stronger linear/nonlinear physical bridge. Wilson intervals summarize Monte Carlo detection counts, not physical evidence.
